items.a: A **wrap-around custom harness** for [[omarchy]] computer-use agents: **QEMU farm** + Kimu proxy + PlanetScale screenshots + Linear tickets. The model is interchangeable; the **proxy, DB log, ISO cache, and client API** are the harness.

items.q: What does a passing run look like?
items.a: Instruction + **proof** pairs. Statuses: pending, running, passed, failed, aborted, timed out. Vision: each Omarchy release, agents explore the delta and ~**two hours** later report what broke — lock screen, user creation, Chrome, app tour.

sections.title: What the stream learned the hard way

items.a: Frames are cheap; **grepping the monolith** is not (~**46k tokens** before a lock-screen click). Split the client; call the API. Soul over-engineers; **Grok produces**, Soul **reviews**. Migrations stay **human** (Drizzle). The experiment run **is** the unit test.

items.q: When are you only an LLM proxy?
items.a: If you **cannot specify how the pieces plug together**. Waiting on agents is a **progress illusion**. UI rule: Vim/CLI or mobile — **no desktop website**.
